say: Business data often holds personal data: customers' phone numbers, pupils' records, staff salaries. Nigeria's Data Protection Act 2023 sets rules for this.

panel.heading: Protect personal data
items: Ask only for the fields you need
Replace names with ID numbers where possible
Share through a business cloud folder
Delete your copies when the project ends

say: At the school, pupil names stay on the school's computer. The builder works on a copy with names replaced by pupil ID numbers.

say: First, her rate. A target of 400,000 naira a month over about 50 billable hours means at least 8,000 naira per hour.
She estimates each phase: discovery, cleaning data, formulas, layout, testing, and instructions with training. That is 31 hours. A 20 percent contingency brings it to 37.
37 hours at 8,000 is 296,000 naira, so she quotes 300,000 for the fixed project.
Half on signing, half on handover.
She also shows the value. The bursar spends about 6 hours each Friday on reports. The tool should cut that to under 1 hour, about 60 hours saved per term.
Write this split in your proposal. Fixing errors, small adjustments and two rounds of revisions are included.
A new report, a new data source or a redesign is a change request. Do not say yes or no straight away. Send a short note with the extra hours, cost and new date, and let the client decide.
Invoice from a business account or a recognised payment platform, and confirm every transfer in your own banking app.

cards.d: Check every payment in your own banking app before releasing files.
Be cautious of clients who overpay and ask for a refund of the difference.
Share screenshots or a PDF for approval. Send the working file once paid.

say: Watch for clients who overpay and ask you to refund the difference. It is a common fraud pattern. Never share your banking login or one-time passwords.

say: Build dashboards with realistic sample data, and say clearly it is sample data. Write each as problem, approach and result, in about 150 words. Never publish a client's real figures without written permission.

say: Contact businesses of that type with personal messages that name one problem you noticed. Start close to home, where trust already exists.

say: Deliver, collect a testimonial, and ask for referrals. Track it all in your own workbook. If 40 messages lead to 4 calls, you need about 10 messages per call.
